gloss: new idea; new design; utility model (patent)

definitions.gloss: new idea; new design; novel proposal
definitions.explanation: A newly devised idea, plan, or design. Also used in patent law as part of {実用|じつよう}{新案|しんあん} (utility model), a category of intellectual property covering minor inventions.

examples.japanese: {新案|しんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新案|しんあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実用|じつよう}→実用：04216_jitsuyou⟧{新案|しんあん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This machine is registered as a utility model.

notes:
Compound of {新|しん} (new) + ⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ (plan, idea). Used in two registers: an everyday sense of 'new idea/proposal' and a legal sense in patent law.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新案|しんあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to put forward a new idea
- ⟦{実用|じつよう}→実用：04216_jitsuyou⟧{新案|しんあん}: utility model (patent category)
- {新案|しんあん}⟦{特許|とっきょ}→特許：13467_tokkyo⟧: utility model patent

LEGAL CONTEXT:
In Japanese patent law, ⟦{実用|じつよう}→実用：04216_jitsuyou⟧{新案|しんあん} (utility model) is a separate, lower-bar form of protection than ⟦{特許|とっきょ}→特許：13467_tokkyo⟧ (full patent) — typically for minor improvements to existing products.
